title: The Link Library WordPress plugin before 7.10.0 does not verify that a requested link belongs to the settings set…
description: The Link Library WordPress plugin versions before 7.10.0 have a vulnerability where it does not verify that a requested link belongs to the settings set used to render it. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to access sensitive information such as telephone numbers, email addresses, and submitter names that the settings set is configured not to display.
